summary.name: Dating Roast
summary.one_liner: An AI tool that critiques uploaded dating app profile screenshots (Tinder, Hinge, Bumble) and returns a score and roast card with feedback on photos, bio, and prompts.
use_cases: Getting honest feedback on dating app photos
Improving a Tinder, Hinge, or Bumble bio
Checking dating prompt answers before going live
Sharing a funny profile score with friends
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool where users upload 3-5 screenshots of their dating profiles from Tinder, Hinge, or Bumble. The AI reads the profile and returns a score plus a roast card with feedback on what photos, bio, and prompts may be hurting match rate. Accepted image formats are PNG, JPG, and WEBP. Each roast costs one credit, and new users get two free credits on signup. The results card can be shared.
notable: Reads Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble profile screenshots
caveats: Paid credit packs needed after the free roasts; the page lists a $2.99 (struck from $4.99) early bird price for 30 credits
Best results are said to come from 3-5 images
Early bird pricing is described as temporary
